title: Real Property Theft and Fraud Laws
summary: This bill establishes new laws and procedures for real property theft and fraud, including recording requirements for certain documents and the creation of new criminal offenses. The bill also sets a statute of limitations and restitution procedures for these offenses. The bill passed the Senate on August 28, 2025, but its final status must be verified.
